mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_message (user_id, type, title, body, project_id, invite_id, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'project_member_removed', #{title}, #{body}, #{projectId}, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO user_message (user_id, type, title, body, project_id, invite_id, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'project_invite', #{title}, #{body}, #{projectId}, #{inviteId}, NULL, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.type, m.title, m.body, m.project_id, m.invite_id, m.read_at, m.created_at, i.status AS invite_status, i.expires_at AS invite_expires_at, a.decision AS my_decision FROM user_message m LEFT JOIN project_invite i ON i.id = m.invite_id LEFT JOIN project_invite_acceptance a ON a.invite_id = m.invite_id AND a.invitee_user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
